snippet.title: One Last Journey Release trailer
snippet.description:
One Last Journey releases on December 30 2025!
Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3801030/One_Last_Journey/

A soul adrift. A memory fading. A journey through the afterlife in search of love, loss... and peace.

One Last Journey is a 2D story-driven platformer set in  the Veil, a place before the afterlife. Play as Selene — a silent spirit — as she navigates ruined cities, flooded tunnels, and the shadows of forgotten souls. Somewhere deep below, a bond waits to be rekindled. But the Hollow spreads, and not everything that lives in the dark has forgotten you.

Music by
SOUND AIRYLUVS by ISAo https://airyluvs.com/
